definitions.gloss: see you later; bye then; well then, goodbye
definitions.explanation: A casual parting greeting used among friends, family, and peers. Implies the expectation of meeting again.

examples.japanese: じゃあまた⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧。
じゃあまた⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。{気|き}をつけて⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。じゃあまた⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぼう→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: That was fun. Well then, let's hang out again sometime.

notes:
A very common informal goodbye. Composed of ⟦じゃあ→じゃあ：02989_jaa⟧ ('well then') and ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧ ('again'). Often followed by a time expression: じゃあまた⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧ ('see you tomorrow'), じゃあまた⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧ ('see you next week'). Adding ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ at the end (じゃあまた⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧) makes it softer and more friendly.

FORMS:
- じゃあまた⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: see you later (softer, friendlier)
- ⟦じゃあ→じゃあ：02989_jaa⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: bye then (shorter, very casual)
- ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: see you later (slightly more formal)
- ⟦じゃ→じゃ：03040_ja⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: same meaning, sometimes written with a comma

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: see you — even more casual shortening
- ⟦さようなら→さようなら：10531_sayounara⟧: goodbye — formal; carries a more final, distant nuance
- バイバイ: bye-bye — very casual, often used by younger speakers
- お{疲|つか}れさまでした: good work / goodbye — used when leaving a workplace
